notes: Cash basis county; all funds governmental. Statement receipts from Exhibit D Total Governmental Funds (p4); Taxes 5,365,176 split with the Statement of Activities general receipts (p2): property general 2,842,109 + property debt service 774,181 + motor vehicle 416,882 + inheritance 1,332,004 = 5,365,176. Charges for services 603,040 kept as printed (SoA: program charges 527,968 + other local receipts 75,072). Exhibit D prints Road/Bridge Fund spending 1,917,039 under General government (kept as printed). Public Works 49,702 is the General Fund Noxious Weed (47,802) and Surveyor (1,900) departments. Nonmajor transfers 14,602 (911 Wireless to Central Communications) net to zero in the Total column; no governmental transfers. Fund balance roll-forward 7,454,973 + 8,451,741 - 7,770,708 = 8,136,006. Ending cash = cash and CDs (printed combined) incl. restricted; no beginning cash printed. Balance sheet from Exhibit C Total column (equals the Statement of Net Position p1). Detail: budget schedules General (pp5-10), Road/Bridge (p11), Inheritance Tax (p12), Debt Service (p13) and nonmajor funds by fund (pp14-16); the combining schedule (p17) is not recorded separately (same funds, less spending detail). Lines with no actual amount are omitted. 'Local' receipt lines kept as other (context label) with the combining/Exhibit D heading noted in review. In the 911 Wireless Service fund the printed total disbursements 35,519 includes Transfers out 14,602. Read pages 1-17 of 17
